summary: Nine of ten selected items are distinct and defensible, but the set is heavily concentrated on Dario Amodei: item_2073414092841455938 (karlmehta, CNN jobs forecast, 235k views) and item_2073513932619206960 (Zephyr_hg, Davos 'software essentially free', only 11 likes / 3.3k views) are the same speaker on adjacent AI-economics themes, and a third Amodei reference appears via item_2073546997521699050 (Sacks rebuttal). The Zephyr_hg item is the weakest link (0 replies, 11 likes) and thematically overlaps the stronger jobs item, so it is flagged same_topic_distinct_angle and marked for replacement with the highest-reach eligible reserve, item_2073470949572452668 (AnatoliKopadze Hinton lecture, 402k views), which restores a distinct foundational-researcher safety voice. karlmehta also appears twice (jobs + Hassabis risks); the two cover different speakers and topics so both are kept, but an overrepresented_author flag is raised. All items carry direct xcancel URLs; no fingerprint collisions or source-traceability failures.
